question.text: During process assessment of an AIF, the functioning of the Investment Committee (IC) is evaluated. A strong IC process would include:

answer.text: The fund manager making all decisions alone without any committee
Investment decisions made over WhatsApp group chats
Documented IC minutes, defined IC composition with external/independent members where applicable, and proposal review with an approval process by majority or consensus
Delegating all investment decisions to junior analysts

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes IC due diligence as covering proposal review, IC composition (with internal/external or independent members), the approval process (such as majority or consensus), recommendations, and documented IC minutes. The Trap: Solo decision-making lacks structured review. Informal communication channels do not provide adequate documentation. Delegation to juniors indicates weak governance. Note: Based on workbook pages 156-158 and 184 covering investment-committee process review.
